deferred.claim: Cast Bilbo's Gambit without promising the gift
deferred.basis: Gift a Treasure (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Treasure token before its other effects. It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.") ... Return target spell to its owner's hand. If the gift was promised, players can't cast spells this turn.
